description: Get the social preview image of a page (what shows when a link is shared): og:image and twitter:image with declared size and alt text, or the first large page image as a fallback. Fast (under 2 s). Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.
